sections.title: Topics in Portuguese, African and Brazilian Cultures
sections.description: This course explores aspects of Luso-Brazilian culture and film in light of its social context and reception. For current course content, please see department's webpage: https://www.sas.upenn.edu/hispanic-portuguese-studies/pc.
